remarks: Charming MidCentury Stone Home with Endless Potential in Norwalk. Discover a rare opportunity to reimagine this classic 1940s stone house, nestled in a desirable Norwalk location. Bursting with character, this solidly built home offers timeless curb appeal and a strong foundation for your vision. Inside, you'll find traditional midcentury features and a layout ready for thoughtful updating. Whether you're dreaming of a modern renovation, an expanded floor plan, or a complete transformation, the possibilities are truly wideopen. Set on a generous lot, the property provides excellent potential for expansion or subdividing living enhancements, or future value growth. Bring your creativity and contractor-this is your chance to design the home you've always wanted while making a smart investment in a sought-after Fairfield County community. Perfect for renovators, builders, or buyers looking to customize their next home, this is a must see opportunity with incredible upside. Sold in "as is" condition
